reason: GroupPermissionsV2.canManage() (GroupPermissionsV2.java:65-71, added by the patch) returns hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE), so an all-groups VIEW grant is enough to pass it. GroupPermissions.requireManage() (GroupPermissions.java:279-283) relies only on canManage(), and GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup (GroupsResource.java:181-202) checks nothing else before createGroup or moveGroup(child, null).
